timeoutMin.label: Deadline (min)
timeoutMin.help: Raise an alarm when there is no sign of life for this long. 1 to 10080 minutes.

mode.label: Sign of life
mode.help: Cloud adapters often rewrite the same value; use 'value change' to catch frozen data.

restartAttempts.label: Instance restarts per outage
restartAttempts.help: 0 = off. Only for states of another adapter instance.
